name: PaneGroup
purpose: Resizable row that lays out the window body: the primary task pane, an optional split pane and an optional right aside, separated by Resizers. Fills the height below the TitleBar (min-h-0 flex-1).

values.when: Body row. Used by the main window.
Stacked panes. Not used in the catalogue; kept for shadcn parity.

props.name: autoSaveId
props.description: Optional key to persist the split ratio per window (undecided).

props.name: onLayout
props.description: Reports pane sizes after drag or reset.

keyboard: None on the group; panes and handles own their keys.
open: Replaces the body-row use of A's Stack (grow fill). B's 'layout wrapper, no fill' replace is a duplicate of A's Stack replace and is kept on Stack, so this widget replaces none. Persistence of the split ratio is undecided. Unit mismatch: task panes size in percent of the group, the aside clamps in px (280 to 420). One rule is needed for both.
